scenario_title: Security group typo blocked the Redis port
title: Elevated 5xx errors on api-gateway
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on api-gateway
symptom: [ANOMALY] api-gateway 2026-04-09 13:07-15:47: api-gateway: 125 of 183 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-04-09 13:07 and 2026-04-09 15:47 UTC (peak error ratio 0.86 vs baseline median 0.0). 1 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 0.576 s vs baseline band up to 0.245 s.

_templates.macro: Terraform change to the {svc} security group opened {new} instead of {old}; auth-svc could not reach Redis and every token check failed.
_templates.remediation: Restore the ingress rule for port {old} on {resource}; add a connectivity check to the pipeline.

rca.macro: Terraform change to the session-cache security group opened 6380 instead of 6379; auth-svc could not reach Redis and every token check failed.
rca.remediation: Restore the ingress rule for port 6379 on aws_security_group.session_cache; add a connectivity check to the pipeline.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `POST <*> <*> <*> target=auth-svc`.
